verdict.rationale: Swell documents stock adjustments (swell-docs-28) and real-time variant inventory tracking (swell-docs-15), but there is no explicit evidence of multi-location/multi-warehouse inventory tracking or location-based fulfillment routing. missing for 10: multi-location inventory data model, per-location stock levels, warehouse/location-based fulfillment routing logic, and any hands-on confirmation of these features.
